title: fix(money): refunds pause billing; repeat cancels and live-contract lifecycle (T4)
body:
## MONEY-REFUND-124 — agent 124

T4: money, access, account-deletion billing. Opening fix round; independent exact-head dual audit required. No merge, deployment, production writes or live provider actions.

### Ordinary-user findings fixed (B=5)
1. **B1 — repeat cancellation:** a client cancels, chooses Keep plan, then cancels again; the lifetime Stripe idempotency key could replay the first response without scheduling the new cancellation.
2. **B2 — renewal refunds:** an operator refunds a renewal; the saved initial PaymentIntent selected the original payment and equal-amount refunds reused a key across renewal charges. The latest settled charge now owns both the refund and its key.
3. **B3 — full-refund lifecycle:** a coach refunds a recurring plan; access could end while Stripe continued billing. Full successful refunds now pause billing and end access, using a distinct refund reason and the existing owning-coach restart. Pending refunds keep access; cumulative partial refunds and changed renewal prices are assessed against the actual charge. Guest recurring refunds also stop collection.
4. **B4 — coach deletion:** a coach deletes their account while a guest buyer's app-account conversion is pending; the guest subscription was missed because collection checked only the buyer's created user id. Deletion now collects the coach-as-payee direction.
5. **B5 — archive with live billing:** a coach archives a package whose subscribers have access off or are still guests; entitlement-only counting could allow ongoing Stripe subscriptions behind an archived package. Live contracts and unconverted guests now block archive.

U=1: truthful refund currency and dispute/inquiry wording; no invented seven-day evidence deadline. C=0: frozen edge cases intentionally not investigated.

### Owner defaults preserved
- Full recurring refund: **pause**, never cancel as a substitute; only the owning coach restarts.
- Ordinary mid-period cancellation: keep paid-period access, no automatic refund.
- Cross-coach reassignment via invite entry remains refused; no silent transfer of Stripe billing.
- Archive remains blocked until contracts/access have ended.

### Evidence
- Baseline: f2d2750c4b9200c3fb9e50bda8299eabd17c873d.
- [Failing-before CI lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37516864377): 9 behavior-assertion failures across every B; 2 additional fixture errors corrected in this PR. The pause-failure case passed on the baseline only because of that fixture error and is not counted as baseline proof.
- Candidate proof: this PR's own CI. No extra lane beyond the baseline lane.
- Provider fixtures use synthetic ids and in-memory databases; no external payments.

### Coordination
MONEY-CONNECT-124 owns disjoint package READ methods; this PR owns archive only. MONEY-WEBHOOK-124 owns billing routing and checkout webhook files; this PR leaves both untouched. Companion mobile PR teaches refund-specific copy and owning-coach restart; existing backend/dispute contracts remain supported.
